note: Seeded items for the checked-item pipeline (spec §6.3). `flaw` is the planted defect; `expectedStage` is the first stage that should drop it (7 needs Jev or a model check). Controls have no flaw and must pass every code stage.

item.stem: What is the running time of binary search?

source.quote: Its recurrence is T(n) = T(n/2) + 1, which solves to Theta(log n).
Its running time satisfies T(n) = 2T(n/2) + n.

item.stem: How is the load factor defined?

options.text: The length of the longest chain

source.quote: The load factor alpha is the number of stored keys divided by the number of buckets.

options.text: An upper bound on the growth of a function, up to constant factors, for all large enough inputs

source.quote: Big-O notation gives an upper bound on the growth of a function.

item.stem: Which statements about chaining are true?

options.text: It uses a linked list per bucket

source.quote: Chaining stores colliding keys in a linked list at each bucket.

item.stem: What problem does linear probing suffer from?

source.quote: Linear probing checks the next slot in order and suffers from primary clustering.

item.stem: Which of these is not dropped in asymptotic analysis?

source.quote: Constant factors and lower-order terms are dropped, so 3n^2 + 5n is Theta(n^2).

item.stem: Open addressing stores every key where?

options.text: Open addressing stores every key in the table itself

source.quote: Open addressing stores every key in the table itself and probes for an empty slot.

item.stem: How many levels does the merge sort recursion tree have?

source.quote: The recursion tree for merge sort is log n levels deep.

item.stem: How should your Homework 3 hash table resolve collisions?

source.quote: Implement a hash table that resolves collisions by chaining

item.stem: What is a collision in a hash table?

source.quote: When two keys map to the same bucket, the table has a collision.

item.stem: What running time does the merge sort recursion tree give, and why?
item.key: Theta(n log n): log n levels, n work per level

source.quote: The recursion tree has log n levels and each level does n work
